sources_used: sec-data/cat3-european/ITRK.L/annual-text/2026.txt (Intertek Annual Report 2025 - FY24, FY25 segmented + Group total)
_ordering_rationale: PV decroissante : Consumer Products (le segment le plus profitable, 48% OP), Industry & Infrastructure (segment de taille), CA total Group, Corporate Assurance, Adjusted operating margin.

kpis.signal: Division la plus profitable (48% OP groupe 2025), marge 30.4% (+250bps), pilier PV ITRK
kpis.description_fr: Division Consumer Products (Softlines, Hardlines, Electrical, GTS) : tests ATIC produits consommation. 29% du CA et 48% de l'OP du groupe FY25. Marge 30.4% (+250bps cc).
kpis.description_en: Consumer Products division (Softlines, Hardlines, Electrical, GTS): consumer goods ATIC testing. 29% of revenue and 48% of group OP FY25. 30.4% margin (+250bps cc).

kpis.signal: Division stable ~860M GBP, LFL growth 4.7% FY25 cc, marge en hausse (~11%)
kpis.description_fr: Division Industry & Infrastructure : services inspection technique, asset integrity, testing materiaux. LFL +4.7% FY25 cc, OP 95.4M GBP (+24% cc).
kpis.description_en: Industry & Infrastructure division: technical inspection, asset integrity, materials testing. LFL +4.7% FY25 cc, OP GBP 95.4M (+24% cc).

kpis.signal: LFL +4.3% cc FY25, croissance organique progressive, AAA strategy en livraison
kpis.description_fr: CA total Intertek = somme des 5 divisions (CP, CA, H&S, I&I, WoE). LFL +4.3% cc FY25 conformement aux objectifs medium-term (mid-single digit).
kpis.description_en: Total Intertek revenue = sum of 5 divisions (CP, CA, H&S, I&I, WoE). LFL +4.3% cc FY25 in line with medium-term targets (mid-single digit).

kpis.signal: LFL +6.8% cc FY25 - 2eme plus forte croissance LFL, certification/audit B2B
kpis.description_fr: Division Corporate Assurance : certification systemes (ISO etc), audits qualite et chaine appro. LFL +6.8% cc FY25, marge 23%.
kpis.description_en: Corporate Assurance division: systems certification (ISO etc), quality and supply chain audits. LFL +6.8% cc FY25, 23% margin.

kpis.signal: Marge 18.1% atteint cible medium-term 18.5%+ approchee, progression structurelle +150bps en 2 ans
kpis.description_fr: Marge operationnelle ajustee Intertek. FY25 = 619.6/3431.6 = 18.1% (+70bps YoY). Cible medium-term 18.5%+ presque atteinte. Source AR 2025.
kpis.description_en: Intertek adjusted operating margin. FY25 = 619.6/3431.6 = 18.1% (+70bps YoY). Medium-term target 18.5%+ nearly reached. Source AR 2025.
